hook_line: INDIA CUTS VISA CATEGORIES FROM 13 TO NINE, RENAMES TOURIST VISA AS VISITOR VISA

hook_stat.sub: Main visa categories India will consolidate into nine

stats.label: Sub-categories, cut under the Home Ministry's Visa Manual review
Of visa application form fields to be cut as overlapping and repetitive

diaspora_bullets: V-1 is for short visits, V-2 for longer stays
Visitor Visa covers visiting friends or relatives
news_summary: India will consolidate its 13 main visa categories into nine and cut sub-categories from 49 to 23 under a Union Home Ministry review of the Visa Manual, 2019, renaming the Tourist Visa as the Visitor Visa.
payoff: Applicants should keep using the current categories until the new structure is notified.
